projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. Oily target (scalp-concern) but no not_suited fit, so T6 changes nothing. T4: W high confidence; C neighbor moderate keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.

projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular; equals the dehydriert-fettig expectation. I3: neighbor none -> no flag.
